items.title: Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1959-01-02
items.q: The interviewee refers to the interviewer as 'Bill' multiple times (e.g., 'My father is named William Marrero. ... My father was 47 when he died, Bill.'), indicating the person named 'Bill Nath' is the interviewer, not a subject of the interviewee's personal history.

ctx.x: Your father, of course, was a well-known musician, Billy Marrero. What was his full name? Do you know?
Yeah, Bill. My father is named William Marrero.
Everybody called him Billy. Everybody called him Billy for short. Do you have a middle name, do you remember?
